name: Jellyfish
description: Jellyfish - the gelatinous drifters that, after the sardine collapse of the 1970s, became this ecosystem's dominant plankton eaters, to the point that few animals prey on them. Life-stage group pooling the source model's juvenile and adult jellyfish stanzas: the two were measured separately (juveniles graze phytoplankton, adults mix phytoplankton, zooplankton and half-digested detritus) and are pooled here to keep the web within this atlas's 25-node ceiling.
